scripts.dev: bun run build:web && bun run bundle:main && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.build:web: ATLAS_STREAM_URL=wss://agent.byatlas.io/stream bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf web-standalone && cp -R ../web/.next/standalone web-standalone && bun scripts/flatten-web-deps.ts web-standalone && bun scripts/drop-native-web-deps.ts web-standalone && mkdir -p web-standalone/apps/web/.next && cp -R ../web/.next/static web-standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -R ../web/public web-standalone/apps/web/public
scripts.build:app: bun run build:web && bun run bundle:main && electrobun build --env=stable && bun run make:dmg
